opening.argument: The video walks through concrete Office 365 administration tasks. It identifies the admin center as the main tool, shows a Service Health page with advisories and a Usage page with activity charts, and explains how usage reporting tracks adoption. It also describes PowerShell for automating repetitive management tasks and APIs for integrating management tools into existing solutions. Those specific tools and dashboards support the stated instructional purpose: explaining how administrators monitor services, review usage, and manage Office 365.

citations.quote: The main tool is the Office 365 admin center.
And if you need more advanced service management, run scripts through PowerShell to automate repetitive tasks and access additional capabilities.
And you can use Office 365 APIs to integrate management tools into your existing solutions.
